I am old now, fifty years, and I never went to school. This small wheat plot is only a quarter hectare, close to my house. I will do like last year — put a little DAP at planting if the cooperative brings it in time, but no urea because one bag is too much money for such a small piece of land. I save my manure from the cattle for the plot near the house, and I use my own seed from last harvest like my mother taught me. My sons help me with the oxen for plowing, and I do the weeding myself with my daughter-in-law.
